correctness.rationale: At ranks j~n^gamma (gamma=1/a), np_j=c(j/n^gamma)^(-a). Exact binomial rare-count asymptotics and two-label multinomial covariance give a concentrated conditional intensity m_n sum_j p_j 1{N_j(n)=r-1}; its diagonal variance is O(n^(-gamma)) on compact rank intervals and off-diagonal covariance O(n^(-1)). The probability of repeating an eligible label twice in the short future window is O(n^(-gamma)); conditional product Laplace functional differs from Poisson exponential by O(n^(-(1-gamma))). The resulting compact Lipschitz L1 rate is O(n^(-gamma/2)+n^(-(1-gamma))); tail estimates ensure finite global mass. Substitution y=cx^(-a) yields Gamma(r-gamma,1), independent uniform time; actual proof handles fixed R and exact Zipf only. Finite multinomial sanity checks verified but do not prove the asymptotic limits.
